grades.quote: FP64_roundToInteger(bits(N) x, bits(1) I_en, bits(2) rm):
grades.reason: Shows a rounding-mode parameter, but does not connect global state with instruction-specific selection.
Describes vector fixed-point rounding, not floating-point rounding control.

grades.quote:
|Rounding Mode|Mnemoni c|Meaning|
|---|---|---|
|000|RNE|Round to Nearest, ties to Even|
|001|RTZ|Round towards Zero|
|010|RDN|Round Down (towards )|
|011|RUP|Round Up (towards )|
|100|RMM|Round to Nearest, ties to Max Magnitude|
|101||Reserved for future use.|
|110||Reserved for future use.|
|111|DYN|In instruction’s rm field, selects dynamic rounding mode; In Rounding Mode register, reserved.|
grades.reason: Directly explains instruction-specific rounding encodings and the selection of the global dynamic rounding mode.

grades.quote: `FCSR3` is the alias of the `RM` field in `FCSR0` . Its location is the same as in `FCSR0` .
grades.reason: Documents the global floating-point rounding-mode field and its alias, but not instruction-specific selection.
